priorReadiness.scope: Original source-only zero-registration readiness; this amendment adds authorized prospective metadata and pure binding tests.

method: Explicitly root-notified terminal native audit. Independent v12 signed/current raw package-contract interpreter and exhaustive recursive enumeration fixes all19facts/all18contracteligibilities/feasible optimal ties/8business operands before any author comparison. Per-field sufficient current operand proofs and all48 criteria are independently derived. Mock JSON actions exercise actual three-stage VM and native runner, then exact actions/tool-results/state/config/cost/status/criteria replay. Only explicitly listed root-notified terminal native panels are read and engineering-audited.
independence: Reuses own previously non-author v12 raw interpreter; old coverage/ledger/receipt formulas were explicitly inherited from non-author v11 source audit. V11 native-auditor evidence and lifecycle criterion structure is reused with added current signed dependency/exclusion/cycle feasibility. Author derive/optimizer/gold is never called for expected truth. Authored case generator internally computes annotations; comparisons occur only after raw vectors are fixed. Reviewer authored the earlier v12 source/runner independent-review artifacts and this audit driver, but did not author engine, cases or core. Actual public VM is reused for replay, not independently reimplemented. Mock completion transport cannot invoke a provider.

prospectiveConditions.conditions: Any paid use still requires independent full v11 terminal admission, a separate cross-provider/controller review, whole remaining-session forecast admission, prospective committed registration and explicitly notified terminal receipts. Readiness establishes no affordability or inference authority.

empiricalApprovalScope: Exact notified terminal engineering measurement consistency under the frozen extracted-text adapter condition only; no professional validity, difficulty localization, general model ranking, pure-model protocol attribution or causal claim.

fields.text: Select the highest signed demand version for each claimant. A replacement uses its own complete verified delivery receipt instant and duration; amount_only inherits the original demand's complete receipt, root and duration. For extensions select the highest signed extension revision for that claimant; it applies only if recipientAuthorized=true, root matches the operative root, and received strictly before the unextended deadline. Add extraMinutes only when it applies. The delivery receipt starts the response clock; its missingItems inventory describes additional internal proposal-packet enclosures, not clock-start delivery prerequisites. Missing required packet items block packages for that claimant. A deadline earlier than reading clock blocks packages; equality is on time. Receipt and a human review are different.

A proposal package is eligible only if every positive claimant allocation is covered, has a current complete receipt packet, has an operative deadline no earlier than reading clock, and its named requiredAllocationKey is resolved or empty. Select any subset of eligible packages with no duplicate IDs. Its per-claimant allocations may not exceed the corresponding available per-person capacity; its total cost may not exceed shared BI occurrence capacity. Maximize the sum of priorityValue. All feasible tied optimal subsets are accepted, without ordering or lexicographic tie breaking. A reported optimum without an actually recorded feasible optimal package selection does not complete the business task.

Current component contracts are the highest signed package revision effective no later than reading clock, scoped by packageId within this occurrence; unsigned/future-effective revisions do not replace it. Equal eligible revisions must agree on contract terms; conflicting terms are an invalid source dataset. Optional requiresPackageIds and excludesPackageIds arrays default to empty. Individually eligiblePackageIds describes only coverage/receipt/deadline/allocation-key eligibility of offered current components, not whether their prerequisites are selectable. A whole plan must include every selected component's named prerequisites, with their costs/allocations/priorities counted normally. Prerequisite cycles are allowed only as complete all-or-none bundles. If either selected component names the other in excludesPackageIds, they cannot coexist; self-exclusion forbids selecting that component. Missing prerequisite IDs make a selected plan infeasible. Contracts are internal component-coordination constraints, never payment authority. These whole-plan constraints apply in addition to the capacity/eligibility rules, and every tied optimum remains accepted.

requiredBeforeNativeApproval: Exact committed prospective registration/source/corpus/freeze and all planned panel conditions must be bound before native reads.
Each terminal panel must be explicitly authorized by root; no discovery, partial output or holdout reads.
Bind actual receipt SHA/native byte SHA/model/effort/taskorder/split/limits/prompt/harness/format/coverage/cost and independently reconstruct cumulative flags.
Audit all planned terminal episodes/actions/results/final-state/all48criteria/whole-task macro including failures, incomplete episodes and current optimal written plan.
The exact frozen commit and explicit root-notified terminal IDs must be set only after respective authorization; arguments cannot grant authority by themselves.
limitations: Source and mock success are engineering controls; no model result, difficulty estimate, ability ranking, expert validity or causal comparison is established.
Three correlated fictional task families and one fixed development case per family limit empirical precision.
Evidence bundles are sufficient formal operands, not minimum references or narrative/prose validation. Correct facts gate evidence and draft criteria.
Current business outcome is measured from actual current saved write with selected current signed contracts, requires/exclusions/cycles and all valid optimal ties, independently of declared optimum.

Native traces retain extracted flattened response text without output-block or response-phase metadata. Parser interface errors are verified at that extracted-text boundary; pure model versus transport/block-concatenation attribution is unresolved and excluded from approval.
Native costs recompute successful trace tariffs; failed-call reservations or billing are outside audit. Only temporary disposable mock budget files are used.
